However, they face a setback with the injury of key defender Nicolás Otamendi, which could leave their backline vulnerable against Real Madrid's speed and agility. The return of João Mário adds depth to their midfield and can be crucial in dictating the pace of the game.

Real Madrid

The midfield trio of Luka Modrić, Federico Valverde, and Toni Kroos has proven to be effective, controlling games and providing vital assists. However, Ancelotti has concerns over the fitness of some key players, including David Alaba.
